Container.Name: AutoGPT
Container.License: LicenseRef-PolyForm-Shield-1.0.0 AND SSPL-1.0 (image); MIT (template source and documentation)
Container.Overview: Run the complete AutoGPT Platform in one experimental single-node container, including the web app, APIs, workers, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Valkey, and FalkorDB-backed memory. This distribution is intended for local and small deployments, not high availability. First startup takes several minutes and uses approximately 5-6 GiB of memory. Model-provider credentials are optional at startup; features that need one return their normal missing-credential error. Registration is enabled initially for the intended first account. Promote that account, then disable new registrations before exposing AutoGPT beyond your trusted network.
Container.Requires: Experimental single-node distribution; not a high-availability deployment. Before stopping AutoGPT through Unraid, set Settings > Docker > Docker Stop Timeout to at least 360 seconds; this global setting overrides the container timeout. Set Public URL to the exact origin used in the browser, including the selected host port. The WebUI shortcut uses the server IP over HTTP; when Public URL uses a hostname, HTTPS, or reverse proxy, open the configured URL directly. Enter the intended first account email. After signup, run docker exec AutoGPT autogpt-admin promote your-email@example.com, then edit this template and set Allow New Accounts to false. The workload has used approximately 5-6 GiB in testing; leave additional memory headroom for Unraid and other applications. Support: https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/autogpt-unraid/issues

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the AutoGPT web interface. The container port remains 3000.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent accounts, agents, databases, memory, workspaces, and generated secrets.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser origin, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000. If this differs from the HTTP server-IP WebUI shortcut, open this configured URL directly.

Config.Name: First Account Email
Config.Description: Exact email address allowed to create the initial account.

Config.Name: Allow New Accounts
Config.Description: Leave true for first setup. Set false after creating and promoting the intended account.
